findings.summary: The writer-function migration requires PUBLIC EXECUTE to exist before revoking it, but every refresh replays all migrations without restoring pg_catalog privileges, so the second refresh—and the first after support performs the revocations—will fail.

Task 4 omits the named spec §5.1 requirements to reject missing MD5s, verify source/destination MD5 listings and enforce the reviewed rclone version, allowing size-only comparisons to mark changed same-size objects as successfully backed up.

Task 26's typed Files list omits creation of supabase/setup/rehearsal-fixture.sql and modifications to apply-migrations.mjs and its test, although its execution steps require those changes, leaving the declared task targets incomplete.
